divergencePoints: Execution-location for `work group add` uses PlannerConfiguration.defaults (FileWorkGroupRepository.fs:84) rather than the configuration the planner runs with
Two member-progress categorisations: GroupDeclaration.progress (checkpoint, recorded state) vs GroupView.progress (show, planner MemberStatus)
Unknown-group message duplicated as a literal in WorkGroupCommands.fs:366 alongside GroupRejection.UnknownGroup
Provenance stored as actor-id strings instead of the existing structured Actor/ActorJson model

P/tree/src/Ros.Infrastructure/Planning/FilePlanningRepository.fs:181 repositoryName moved into FileWorkGroupRepository, so the planner's repository now depends on the group repository

P/tree/src/Ros.Domain/Planning/WorkGroups.fs:181,370 create needs >=1 member, remove can empty a group with --allow-empty, validate does not flag empty groups, checkpoint refuses them (explicit, but the member-count rule lives in four places)

P/tree/src/Ros.Cli/GroupCommands.fs:144-175 one mutate pipeline: document {command, schemaVersion, groupId, status}, coded rejections, persistence-failed coded, argument rejections exit 2
probe: `work group show GROUP-NOPE-001 --json` -> empty stdout, stderr text 'ERROR no group ... is declared', rc=1 (evaluation/probes/P.probe.txt); GroupCommands.fs:416,421 show errors ignore --json
P/tree/src/Ros.Contracts/Planning/WorkGroupJson.fs:304 show JSON has command/schemaVersion but no status field, unlike the mutation documents
P/tree/src/Ros.Cli/GroupCommands.fs:30 copies ProvenanceCommands' identityFlags list

P/tree/src/Ros.Cli/GroupCommands.fs:128 withLock and :144 mutate cover create/add/remove/checkpoint uniformly; lockprobe: create blocked while work-protocol held, nothing written (evaluation/probes/lock.probe.txt)
P/tree/src/Ros.Domain/Work/Checkpoint.fs:468-476 verifyDurableLocation copies the location+tree logic that verify keeps at :437-441, so the durability rule now exists twice
P/tree/src/Ros.Cli/GroupCommands.fs:342-345 Git observation and verification composed in the CLI layer, not behind an application/infrastructure seam
Positive: content-addressed checkpoint IDs reuse CanonicalJson (FileWorkGroupRepository.fs:89) and validate checks them

divergencePoints: Second JSON parser/serialiser module (WorkGroupJson) for the declared-group concept alongside PlanningJson's grouping.groups parser
Second execution-location rule (catalog) diverging from Grouping's planner rule
Durable-checkpoint verification duplicated (Checkpoint.fs verifyDurableLocation vs verify)
Validation rules restated in WorkGroups.validate instead of reusing admit
repositoryName ownership moved from FilePlanningRepository to FileWorkGroupRepository (dependency inversion of the planner on the group store)
show's --json error path diverges from the mutation commands' JSON contract

Unknown-group message duplicated in three places

Store writer uses a fixed temp-file name unlike the base atomic-write helpers
